semantics.mapping_lifetime: entire client process across sequential finalized windows with identical ordered actors
semantics.next_window_policy: step zero only after successful finalization; reuse the original actor-to-gateway mapping
semantics.retry_policy: identical actor-to-gateway mapping and identical finalize request replay
semantics.successful_transport_events_by_default: durable per-request records plus the aggregate vector-step record
semantics.transport_errors_and_retries: forwarded to the durable run telemetry
